ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity (off-white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant light-toned central field with dark pigmentation concentrated at the distal tips, along the entirety of the trailing edge, and at the peduncle insertion point; several isolated dark focal spots are present in the lower right lobe quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 40 degrees and a sharp vertex convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary; the right lobe exhibits higher amplitude peaks (up to 30 pixels) compared to the left; the edge is punctuated by jagged, non-uniform tissue variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve leading to tapered, slightly upturned distal tips; overall fluke shape is broad with a distinct posterior sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, brownish-white textured nodes (barnacles) concentrated on the extreme distal tips and the lower outer margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal dark linear disruptions on the mid-left lobe; a prominent dark vertical streak is visible at the base where the fluke meets the water surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular serration along the trailing edge margin indicative of historic tissue loss or wear; significant biological encrustation on both lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, isolated dark circular spot located in the upper-mid region of the left lobe's light-toned field.
